	<ResortReportHeadline>13 cm in 24 hours!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It should be a pretty good day on the hill.&nbsp; Not quite the 50-year storm, but we picked up another 13 cm during the day yesterday and we should see more snow later today and tomorrow.&nbsp; &nbsp;The sky is clear to the east and cloud is moving in from the west.&nbsp; The current temperature is minus 1.6, heading for a top of minus 1, and the wind is a moderate westerly.</p><p>The slight warming late yesterday, followed by the cooling in the last few hours has stiffened the snow surface, but there should still be really good turns to be had out there.&nbsp; The groomers will be in good shape and there'll be fun to be had off-piste as well....just watch out for the very thin crust in places.</p><p>The wind has backed off enough that I think all scheduled lifts should be right to go this morning.&nbsp; Get out there and get into it.</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

	<Backcountry>11 August
13 cm in 24 hours, however that all fell during the day yesterday.  The sight warming late in the day, followed by cooling in the last few hours has left a very thin crust on the surface.  It will probably be skiing and riding ok in some areas but may be challenging in others.  Take care out there.  </Backcountry>
